contracts.process_ownership: Create a private Linux group; retain exclusive wait ownership of unreaped leader; observe WNOWAIT, signal owned group, then reap direct child. ECHILD disarms numeric-ID cleanup after known ownership loss.
contracts.output: Fair concurrent nonblocking reads; retain at most1MiB per pipe and continue discarding overflow while initiating failure cleanup.
contracts.deadlines: Existing call-site timeout remains; post-kill direct-child/pipe cleanup is capped at2s. Actual manager does not supply host cancellation in Stage A.
contracts.drop: Kill while child identity is still owned, then transfer direct PID to pre-reserved upstream runtime-independent reaper. Deferred reaping is not proof of successful normal cleanup.
contracts.normal_return: Confirms direct child reaped and both pipes closed, after signalling the group. Does not prove every group member gone/reaped.
contracts.nonlinux: Legacy helper retained on nonLinux; HEAD lookup is rerouted through that existing timeout helper on all platforms. New process-group and bounded-pipe cleanup are Linux-only. NonLinux behavior remains untested.
